description:
Outcome: Allocated gardener reports a problem, from brief.md / First version 4 and Constraints.
Scope: Plain-text report associated with household, plot and season. Excludes: plot map/grid, payments, tool lending, attachments, public contact directory.
Acceptance: Exactly one persisted report on retry; immediately visible to coordinator; cannot report against another plot.
Behaviour: Accessible phone form, validation, submission confirmation and draft preservation on failure. All interfaces use phone-friendly large text, plain language, accessible labels and keyboard operation; server-side role/household authorization.
Verification: Own-plot authorization, retry and input tests plus phone journey. Prerequisites: T-002, T-003, T-006. Assumptions: Editable March 1–October 31 defaults; garden timezone configured; coordinator-confirmed households; application receipt timestamp plus stable sequence for ties; preferences advisory; no automatic vacancy-offer expiry; 09:00 daily digest without empty emails. Framework/providers and finite retention periods settled in A/N. See setup handover.
title: Report an own-plot problem
